name: github-release-upload-crosscompiled-assets
description: Update atau buat GitHub Release untuk tag tertentu, cross-compile binary Linux/Windows/macOS, buat checksum, lalu upload semua asset ke release.

args.command:
set -e
TAG="__PARAM__tag"
REPO="__PARAM__repo"
BIN="__PARAM__binary_name"
MAIN="__PARAM__main_package"
NOTES="__PARAM__release_notes"

rm -rf dist
mkdir -p dist

build_one() {
  GOOS="$1" GOARCH="$2" EXT="$3"
  OUT="dist/${BIN}"
  [ -n "$EXT" ] && OUT="${OUT}${EXT}"
  echo "Building ${GOOS}/${GOARCH}..."
  CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS="$GOOS" GOARCH="$GOARCH" go build -trimpath -ldflags "-s -w -X main.version=${TAG}" -o "$OUT" "$MAIN"
  PKG="${BIN}-${TAG}-${GOOS}-${GOARCH}"
  if [ "$GOOS" = "windows" ]; then
    (cd dist && zip -q "${PKG}.zip" "${BIN}.exe")
    rm -f "dist/${BIN}.exe"
  else
    (cd dist && tar -czf "${PKG}.tar.gz" "${BIN}")
    rm -f "dist/${BIN}"
  fi
}

build_one linux amd64 ""
build_one windows amd64 ".exe"
build_one darwin amd64 ""
build_one darwin arm64 ""

(cd dist && sha256sum * > SHA256SUMS.txt)

if [ "$NOTES" = "auto" ]; then
  NOTES_FILE="versions/RELEASE_${TAG}.md"
else
  NOTES_FILE="$NOTES"
fi

if [ ! -f "$NOTES_FILE" ]; then
  mkdir -p versions
  NOTES_FILE="versions/RELEASE_${TAG}.md"
  {
    echo "# Release ${TAG}"
    echo
    echo "Updated GitHub Release assets for ${TAG}."
    echo
    echo "## Assets"
    echo "- Linux amd64"
    echo "- Windows amd64"
    echo "- macOS amd64"
    echo "- macOS arm64"
  } > "$NOTES_FILE"
fi

if command -v gh >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  if gh release view "$TAG" --repo "$REPO" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    gh release edit "$TAG" --repo "$REPO" --title "$TAG" --notes-file "$NOTES_FILE" --latest
  else
    gh release create "$TAG" --repo "$REPO" --title "$TAG" --notes-file "$NOTES_FILE" --latest
  fi
  gh release upload "$TAG" dist/* --repo "$REPO" --clobber
else
  echo "gh CLI belum tersedia/login. Compile selesai di dist/, upload release dilewati."
  exit 1
fi

echo "Release ${TAG} updated and assets uploaded to ${REPO}."

params.name: tag
params.description: Tag release yang ingin diupdate, contoh v1.20.0

params.name: main_package
params.description: Path package main Go untuk build

params.name: release_notes
params.description: Path release notes atau auto untuk pakai versions/RELEASE_<tag>.md kalau ada
